data.description: Binghatti Apex: A Landmark of Luxury Living in JVC
data.display_address: Binghatti Apex, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai
data.long_description:
In the heart of JVC, Binghatti Apex stands tall as a beacon of modern luxury. The 45-storey tower is home to exclusive studios and 1-bedroom apartments, alongside office spaces spread across four floors, perfect for entrepreneurs and professionals.

The building’s striking design combines contemporary architecture with the charm of traditional Middle Eastern influences. Glass panels enhance the exterior’s beauty, while the interiors feature elegant finishes and premium materials for a luxurious living experience.

Residents at Binghatti Apex can enjoy numerous amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym, tennis courts, jogging tracks, and a large swimming pool. Children will enjoy the play areas and a dedicated pool, while adults can unwind in the outdoor yoga or relaxation areas.

Strategically located near Al Khail Road, Binghatti Apex provides easy access to Dubai’s most renowned destinations. Just 15 minutes to the Mall of Emirates and 20 minutes to iconic locations like the Burj Al Arab and Dubai Marina.
